# Escapes {#escapes}

0.2 reads some text as syntax that 0.1 printed as typed: a line that starts with `=`, a letter marker with one space, a shortcut reference with a definition. To keep the 0.1 output, the tool escapes the character that would start the new reading.

::: warning Escapes may still change
The writer escape rules get one data-driven procedure after 0.2.0 ([#6579](https://github.com/markup-carve/carve/issues/6579)). The escaped spellings below may change with it.
:::

**U-101** <Badge type="warning" text="escape" /> <Badge type="warning" text="silent" /> `=` at the start of a paragraph, an item or a quote

::: compare no-render
```text
= 4 is the answer
and more.
```
```crv
\= 4 is the answer
and more.
```
:::

**U-102** <Badge type="warning" text="escape" /> <Badge type="warning" text="silent" /> Indented line directly under a heading

::: compare no-render
```text
# Heading
  indented text
```
```crv
= Heading

indented text
```
:::

**U-103** <Badge type="warning" text="escape" /> <Badge type="warning" text="silent" /> Letter marker with one space

::: compare no-render
```text
a. one
b. two
```
```crv
a\. one
b\. two
```
:::

**U-104** <Badge type="warning" text="escape" /> <Badge type="warning" text="silent" /> Quote fence or line block with a title

:::: compare no-render
```text
::: > "T"
quoted
:::
```
```crv
\::: > "T"
quoted

:::

:::
```
::::

**U-105** <Badge type="warning" text="escape" /> <Badge type="warning" text="silent" /> Raw fence with a title

````text
```
````
````crv

<b>x</b>`

```
```
````

**U-110** <Badge type="warning" text="escape" /> <Badge type="warning" text="silent" /> Full reference whose label is a heading

```text

See [My Heading][] and [the text][My Heading].
```

```crv
See [My Heading][] and \[the text]\[My Heading].
```
:::

```text
label] here.
```
